// Notes: These settings wire the Assert.IQ Agent Pack into VS Code + Copilot.
Setting names may vary slightly across VS Code / Copilot versions; adjust as needed.
The intent is: load instruction files automatically, and look for prompt files
chat.hookFilesLocations points VS Code at the pack's own rendered
session-events.json (a clean {hooks:{SessionStart,Stop}} file VS Code Copilot
parses natively). The .claude/* paths are disabled here so VS Code does NOT
read .claude/settings.json — that file carries a Claude-only 'permissions' key
VS Code's hook loader rejects, which silently stops Dreaming from firing.
Claude Code reads .claude/settings.json natively (not via this setting), so
both harnesses fire from one rendered source without double-firing.
